meta.title: AMD Ross AI Assistant
meta.description: Unofficial DSH fork of Xilinx/ross-ai-assistant. The AMD Ross skills for Vivado, Vitis HLS, Vitis AI, Versal segmented configuration, and embedded software are unchanged; this fork adds the DeepSeek Harness bundle, Settings page, and install documentation. Configure the Vivado and documentation MCP servers in Settings → AMD Ross.
